label: What each check proves
subgoals: Bound what simulation proves by the vectors run
Use combinational equivalence when the registers correspond
Use sequential equivalence when registers or encodings changed

label: Differential checks for an edit
subgoals: Require full equivalence for a refactoring edit
Constrain equivalence to unchanged modes for a functional edit
Compare synthesis QoR before and after

subgoals: Check behavior from illegal states when recovery is required
Keep the golden reference independent of both versions
State X semantics and reset assumptions with every pass
